sets.source:
import { allow, auth, collection } from "canopy.js/policy"
export default { collections: [
collection("notes", {
  exposed: true,
  realtime: true,
  policies: [
    allow
      .read("authenticated")
      .where({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("read own"),
    allow
      .insert("authenticated")
      .check({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("create own"),
    allow
      .update("authenticated")
      .where({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .check({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("edit own"),
    allow
      .delete("authenticated")
      .where({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("delete own"),
  ],
  fields: { write: { default: { only: ["text", "ownerId", "createdAt"] } } },
  immutable: ["ownerId", "createdAt"],
})
], contexts: {} }

import { allow, auth, collection } from "canopy.js/policy"
export default { collections: [
collection("topics", {
  exposed: true,
  policies: [allow.read("authenticated").named("read topics")],
}),
collection("posts", {
  exposed: true,
  realtime: true,
  policies: [
    allow.read("authenticated").named("read posts"),
    allow
      .insert("authenticated")
      .check({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("create own"),
    allow
      .delete("authenticated")
      .where({ ownerId: auth("sub") })
      .named("delete own"),
  ],
  fields: { write: { default: { only: ["title", "topicId", "ownerId"] } } },
  immutable: ["ownerId", "topicId"],
})
], contexts: {} }
